subtitle.en: Seven verses from the Devi Mahatmya

edition.notes: Seven household verses drawn from Devi Mahatmya (Markandeya Purana), collated against Green Message saptashloki. Not the full 700-verse Durga Saptashati. Meanings provisional. Not a tantric paddhati.

description.hi: देवी माहात्म्य के सात घर-पाठ श्लोक — पूर्ण सप्तशती नहीं।
description.en: Seven household verses from the Devi Mahatmya — not the full Saptashati.
